name: Phone
description: Your assistant calls businesses for you: book appointments and ask questions, with your approval on every call.
author: Crow

install_consent_messages.en: The phone runner uses host networking, bound to 127.0.0.1 only, so it can reach Crow and your local models. It opens no network ports to other machines.

env_vars.name: PHONE_RUNNER_SECRET
env_vars.description: Shared secret between Crow and the phone runner; must be at least 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

notes: Plan A: calls run on a simulated line (FakeLine). The Bluetooth phone line arrives in a later release. Every call needs owner approval.
